tagline: Leading Finnish bank providing comprehensive banking and financial services to private and corporate customers
hero_kpi_rationale: Aktia's primary revenue source is net interest income (korkokate), which accounts for more than half of its total revenue and is the main driver of its financial performance

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest income received and interest expenses paid.
kpis.description: Korkokate increased by 152.0 million euros due to stronger interest margins and higher benchmark rates, driven by growth in loan interest income (+20%) and liquidity portfolio income (+51%).
kpis.signal: Sustained growth driven by higher interest rates.

kpis.name: Net Fee Income
kpis.explanation: Revenue from banking service fees such as cards and asset management.
kpis.description: Supported by growth in customer average assets (+2%) and fund activities, reaching 124.3 million euros.

kpis.name: Comparable Operating Profit
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit, excluding non-recurring items.
kpis.description: Comparable operating profit rose strongly to 124.5 million euros despite a decline in reported profit, reflecting improved cost control.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement due to better cost discipline.

kpis.name: Personnel Expenses
kpis.explanation: Total cost related to employees, including salaries and benefits.
kpis.description: Comparable personnel expenses decreased to 80.5 million euros due to lower headcount and reduced one-off expenses, partially offset by higher capitalization of development costs.
kpis.signal: Cost reduction driven by lower employee count (FTE).

kpis.name: IT Expenses
kpis.explanation: Costs related to IT systems, infrastructure, and digital projects.
kpis.description: IT expenses increased to 51.5 million euros due to continued investments in banking systems, payment service infrastructure, and asset management, as well as inflationary effects.
kpis.signal: Sharp increase linked to investments in IT infrastructure and modernization.

kpis.name: Life Insurance Net Result
kpis.explanation: Profitability of life insurance operations after claims and expenses.
kpis.description: Life insurance result improved significantly to 30.2 million euros, driven by premium portfolio growth, lower claims incidence, and better investment performance in insurance and asset portfolios.
kpis.signal: Strong performance driven by improved claims experience and growing customer base.

kpis.name: Total Operating Costs
kpis.explanation: Sum of all operating costs of the bank.
kpis.description: Total costs increased slightly to 178.6 million euros, despite lower personnel expenses, due to higher IT spending, absence of stability fund contribution in 2024 (compared to 4.3 million in 2023), and other services.
kpis.signal: Moderate growth despite salary reductions, offset by IT increases.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 11.98 Bn € in the latest year

risks.title: Increased climate regulation risk
risks.score_rationale: The risk is highlighted centrally in the report, with strong emphasis on adapting to EU standards (SFDR, Taxonomy). The trend is upward due to intensifying regulatory frameworks. Regulation is a strategic category for banks.

risks.title: Competition in green products
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions the development of green products in response to an evolving market. The language is measured, but the trend is rising. Competition is a key factor in differentiating sustainable banking services.

risks.title: Dependence on external partners for sustainability
risks.score_rationale: Aktia relies on external partners (e.g., Green Carbon, ISS ESG) to assess climate impacts. The language indicates operational dependency. The trend is stable, but technological risk is moderate.

risks.title: Cybersecurity-related reputational risk
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly links cybersecurity to reputation, a critical point for a bank. The tone is concerned, and the risk is increasing. The category is strategic due to the importance of customer data.

risks.title: Climate transition risk in the portfolio
risks.score_rationale: The risk is well documented, with climate scenarios integrated into credit assessments. The language is technical and preventive. The trend is rising, reflecting growing importance of industrial risk related to transition.

risks.title: Dependence on collective commitments
risks.score_rationale: Aktia participates in initiatives such as Climate Action 100+ and NZAM, implying reliance on collective actions. The language is committed but cautious. The trend is stable, with moderate impact on strategy.

risks.title: Physical climate change risk
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions exposure to physical risks (floods, extreme weather) on real estate assets. The language is evaluative, the trend is rising. The category weight is moderate but increasing.

ai_positioning.summary: Aktia does not disclose any defined strategy or initiative related to artificial intelligence in its reports. AI mentions are absent, and IT investments appear focused on infrastructure and compliance rather than disruptive innovation.
evidence: No mention of AI or machine learning in the 2024 report
IT expenses are described as related to banking infrastructure and payment systems
No references to advanced automation or predictive analytics projects
